description: Returns the ready-to-paste group announcement for this draw, already written for WhatsApp, Telegram, and Slack and localized to language/region. Use this when someone wants a WhatsApp group message, a Telegram or Slack post, or any group-chat text they can paste, including when they ask not to include private links. The group text has the budget and exchange date, and it never includes private links or anyone's assignment. The result also includes a separate private message for each person, to send only to that person, not in the group. Refuses if the draw has not been made.

admin_token.description: Organizer secret returned by create_draw: the token, or the full /m/ URL. It cannot reveal who gives to whom.

language.description: Language of the reply and the share messages: en, es, ca, de, pt, fr, it, nl, pl, da, no, sv, ru, ko, ja. Defaults from region.

region.description: Region code from list_regions (US, ES, CT for Catalonia, DE, MX, …). Sets the local name of the game, the default language and the currency.

name: get_group_share_message
